import sys, numpy as np, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from tests_common import make_case
import te.algorithms.formulations.path_based.distributed.worker as W
orig=W.WorkerProblem.solve
stats={'attempts':[]}
def solve_patched(self):
    if self.n==0: 
        stats['attempts'].append(0); return orig(self)
    x=self.start_point(); best=None
    for i,iters in enumerate((240,1500,8000)):
        x=self.pgd(x,iters)
        supp,tight=self.identify(x)
        pol,mu,t2=self.pivot(supp,tight)
        cand=x if pol is None else pol
        rep=self.build(cand); ok,score=self.check(rep)
        if pol is None: stats.setdefault('pivotfail',[]).append(i)
        if ok:
            stats['attempts'].append(i+1); return rep
        if best is None or score>best[0]: best=(score,rep)
    stats['attempts'].append(-1)
    return best[1]
W.WorkerProblem.solve=solve_patched
t0=time.time()
for seed in range(400):
    nodes,edges,cap,dem,slots=make_case(seed)
    E=len(cap); rng=np.random.default_rng(1000+seed)
    bias=rng.normal(size=E)*0.5*(cap>0); rho=float(rng.integers(1,9))
    for mode in ('route','admit'):
        p=W.solve_worker_proposal(list(range(len(slots))),cap,dem,slots,mode,rho,bias,E)
import collections
print(collections.Counter(stats['attempts']), 'pivotfail', collections.Counter(stats.get('pivotfail',[])))
print('time',time.time()-t0)
PYEOF
